name: TSDF Fusion Mesh Extraction
definition: Performs Truncated Signed Distance Function (TSDF) fusion using Open3D's ScalableTSDFVolume to extract a mesh from 2D Gaussian Splatting depth and color maps within a fixed depth range.
summary: TSDF Fusion Mesh Extraction integrates depth and color maps into a scalable voxel grid to extract a triangle mesh, differing from differentiable methods by relying on explicit geometric fusion.
